$comment: The per-developer skill profiles that community/.ai/skill-profile.mjs applies.
`areas` groups the skills that serve one area. Each skill belongs to one area at most. A skill
that no area names is core: every profile keeps it, and a new skill is therefore on until
somebody puts it in an area. This is one grouping table, not one list for each profile, so a
new skill does not need an edit in each profile.
`profiles` names the areas a role keeps. The script turns off every skill in each other area.
The `off` state hides the skill from the model and from the / menu. Use `--state name-only` to
The script writes to .claude/settings.local.json, which git ignores, so a profile is yours
alone. It records what it wrote in .claude/local/skill-profile.json, and `reset` reads that
record to remove its own entries only.
